items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Who is Turk van Lake? ... [INTERVIEWEE] That's Van Alexander.

ctx.x: I played in that when I went to join his band.
Who is Turk van Lake? I asked you about this person before. You remembered Van Alexander, but Turk van Lake apparently was an arranger.
